name: TextEffect
whenToUse: A hero headline or one key word on a landing page: letters rising in (`split`), a code-like reveal (`scramble`), a soft highlight (`shimmer`), rotating phrases (`typewriter`).

whenNotToUse.text: Body copy, labels, buttons, anything in product UI
More than one animated headline in view at a time
Text people must read quickly (prices, warnings)

anatomy.description: the string itself (`children`), or `phrases` for the typewriter.
split and scramble start in view (default), on hover or on mount (`trigger`).
typewriter only, in the primary icon color.

dont.caption: An effect on running text: harder to read, and it doesn’t stop.
dont.example: <TextEffect effect="shimmer" as="p" className="text-body-s">Your password must be at least 12 characters long.</TextEffect>

a11y: Screen readers get the plain text (every phrase, for the typewriter); the animated letters are aria-hidden.
prefers-reduced-motion: the text simply shows; the typewriter shows its first phrase.
Shimmer falls back to plain text in Windows high contrast.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render: a heading level, `p`, `span` (default).

props.name: phrases
props.description: Typewriter: the phrases it types in turn.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When split / scramble start: in view (default), on hover, or on mount.
